comments: Answers to CLR-TP-EC-12000-004: (1) Accepted -- automate TS-EC-12000-011 through -015 against the dictated-only eoRequestExport endpoint; assertion remains via the UI audit trail only, never the API response. (2) CLEANUP mechanism: on the Work Queue item, click Print, in the Verify Paper Out modal select the select-all checkbox, click Verify, then confirm the alert dialog -- this clears the item from the Work Queue (mirrors the existing MANUAL_ONLY flow in TS-EC-12000-020, confirmed live against qa5 on 2026-09-15). (3) Fixture selection: do not hard-code a single fixture id -- each scenario must dynamically select an available item from the current Collections list (c1 through c5 observed on 2026-09-15) at run time. All 5 changed scenarios (TS-011 through TS-015) approved on this basis.
